statement: For every epsilon in (0,1), the qubit channel Phi_epsilon with Bloch transfer diag(epsilon,0,1-epsilon) is unital, trace-preserving, CPTP, Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint and positive, self-compatible, and canonical EB; nevertheless there is no bistochastic CP map C:M_2->M_2 with Phi_epsilon=C^*C in the Hilbert-Schmidt inner product.
assumptions: M_y effects are epsilon P_x,+, epsilon P_x,-, (1-epsilon) P_z,+, and (1-epsilon) P_z,-
C is both unital and trace-preserving
novelty_boundary: Closes the universal bistochastic CP-square/Petz-instrument representation route only. The example itself has a canonical EB comparator with constant one, so it neither proves nor refutes the universal factor-two comparison.
costs: Exact finite-dimensional algebra; no numerical computation, oracle acquisition, runtime, or precision claim.
falsifier: An explicit bistochastic CP qubit map with C^*C transfer diag(epsilon,0,1-epsilon) for some epsilon strictly between zero and one, or an error in the signed-diagonal reduction or Choi inequalities in the proof.
next_gate: Prove the all-positive-HS-dual canonical POVM support inequality for every finite dimension and every supplied compatible channel, with one POVM for the full frame encoded by each Q; or produce a legal broadcaster and rigorous global support deficit.

statement: The universal finite-dimensional factor-two target is existence, for every admissible (d,Phi,B), of one POVM M such that I-Psi_M <= 2(I-Phi) on all Hermitian inputs; equivalently for every Q>=0 the canonical POVM support function satisfies Tr_HS(Q Psi_M) >= Tr_HS(Q(2Phi-I)) for some M depending on Q, which by compact convex separation yields one M independent of Q.
assumptions: Phi is unital, trace-preserving, CPTP, Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint and positive on Hermitians
B is a supplied CPTP two-output broadcaster whose marginals both equal Phi
The comparison is on the entire Hermitian domain
novelty_boundary: The support-gate equivalence uses the prior internal canonical-majorant lemma. This report adds no proof or counterexample for the gate; its exact qubit obstruction concerns only the stronger CP-square representation.
costs: Mathematical existence statement only; all input channels and broadcaster maps are supplied exactly. No efficient optimization or precision bound is claimed.
falsifier: A proof of the all-Q support gate settles the claim positively; an admissible exact (d,Phi,B,Q) with a rigorous global strict support deficit refutes it.
next_gate: Obtain a dimension-free one-POVM frame inequality from the compatibility/Dirichlet structure, or a legal support-deficit certificate preserving all broadcaster marginals.
